name: store
description: Mod store — CID-agnostic decentralized storage (localfs + filecoin + hippius + lighthouse + external refs) gated by mod protocol auth + per-user quotas, with timed access grants, data pools (mutual access), QR auth handoff between devices, and on-chain BlocTime-gated access + chain Registry registration

backends.docs: GET /backends list; GET /backends/status per-backend configured/needs_key (?probe=1 owner validates creds remotely); POST /backends/key (owner) persist hippius s3_key+s3_secret or lighthouse api_key off-chain in ~/.mod/{backend}/

me.docs: Caller address, admin flag, quota (protocol-auth token)

quota.docs: GET caller usage+limit; POST (owner) set per-user limit

whitelist.docs: List / add / remove allowed uploader addresses (owner only)

put.docs: Upload file/text/image; form: backend, key, public, pool (whitelisted + within quota + signed terms)

terms.docs: GET current terms text+version (+accepted if auth); POST /terms/accept sign-accepts (required before put/register); GET /terms/accepts (owner) audit

rm.docs: Delete own object; the module owner may remove ANY content (e.g. illegal) with ?reason= — logged to the takedown audit

takedowns.docs: Owner-only audit log of admin content removals

register.docs: Reference an external CID (arweave/ipfs-elsewhere/s3/any) without uploading bytes — cid-agnostic

get.docs: Retrieve by CID; private objects need ?token= or Bearer (owner/grant/pool)

preview.docs: Peek object content: up to max_bytes (text decoded if possible) + size + truncated flag

object.docs: Full object info: stored when/by whom, backends, visibility, semhash, pinned, and who has access (grants+pools, owner-only roster)

list.docs: List caller's objects (+ visibility / scheme / external url)

search.docs: Search/filter objects by q (cid/key substring) + backend/scheme/visibility; scope mine|shared|all

shared.docs: Objects shared WITH the caller via grants or pool membership

grants.docs: Timed access grants: POST {grantee,cid?,scope,ttl_seconds}; GET mine; DELETE /grants/{id}

pools.docs: Data pools (mutual access): POST create; GET mine; /pools/{id} members+objects; /members; /objects

handoff.docs: QR auth transfer computer<->phone: POST mints one-time code from session token; GET /handoff/{code} claims it

tickets.docs: One-time access tickets: POST {cid,ttl_seconds=10} mints single-use short-TTL fetch link; GET lists active; GET /ticket/{code} redeems exactly once (anti-replay)

market.docs: Marketplace: GET /market public browse (q/tag/sort/free); POST /market/list list own object w/ title/tags/price_bloc (0=free, >0 = buyer must hold that much BlocTime); POST /market/acquire mints a permanent read grant; POST /market/like; GET /market/mine; DELETE /market/list delist (admin = logged takedown)

onchain.docs: GET /onchain status (Registry + BlocTime gate); GET /onchain/bloctime caller balance; POST /onchain/register (owner) registers in chain Registry

pin.docs: POST pin a CID; GET /pins list caller's pins; DELETE /pin?cid= unpin (whitelisted)

env.STORE_SESSION_TTL: Max token age in seconds (default: 604800 / 7 days)
env.STORE_BLOCTIME_GATE: Set 0/false to disable BlocTime-holder access (overrides config bloctime_gate)
env.STORE_CHAIN_NETWORK: Chain network for BlocTime/Registry (default: config chain_network / testnet)
